title: USF-174 composed search provider disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: Search provider parity is split by semantic requirement. In-memory search is accepted only where service catalogue authority permits it and is not equivalent to Meilisearch composed provider semantics.
humanDecision.implementationStatus: USF-199 profile-gated composed-service proof present; runtime API and worker binding remain outside this issue.

searchProviderDisposition.riskStatement: Meilisearch profile-gated composed proof could be overclaimed as API or worker runtime binding, ranking equivalence, vector search, AI/RAG, live-provider, or environment readiness.
searchProviderDisposition.treatment: USF-199 proves SDK-backed profile-gated local composed service semantics and preserves explicit non-claims for runtime binding and readiness levels.
searchProviderDisposition.deferredEvidence: API and worker runtime binding are not claimed because the current SearchIndexPort is synchronous while the Meilisearch SDK is asynchronous. A later issue must authorize a port-contract change before runtime binding claims.

inMemorySubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: In-memory search proof is not equivalent to Meilisearch composed provider indexing, ranking, filtering, async indexing visibility, persistence, deletion, retention, reindex, SDK/client, readiness retry, provider failure-mode, or wire/API behaviour.
scopeCovered: tenant-safe hermetic search indexing proof where semantically permitted
repository search capability proof posture from USF-164
value-free repository evidence and validation linkage
limits: does not prove Meilisearch adapter binding
does not prove Meilisearch indexing or query compatibility
does not prove ranking, filtering, async indexing, deletion, retention, or reindex behaviour
does not prove Meilisearch SDK/client selection or dependency posture
does not prove provider failure modes, retry, timeout, audit operation evidence, or teardown
does not prove vector, embedding, AI, RAG, live-provider, test, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, or full React parity readiness

providerBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records full-text-search-meilisearch-composed-test as local composed proof-only provider; live/external Meilisearch remains deferred.

semanticProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Hermetic in-memory indexing remains non-equivalent; Meilisearch indexing is proven only in profile-gated local Compose for synthetic documents.
USF-199 proves tenant-filtered Meilisearch query behavior only; ranking equivalence, tokenization equivalence, vector search, and AI/RAG remain unclaimed.
USF-199 proves task-waited async indexing visibility, update/reindex boundary, deletion, and temporary index cleanup for synthetic data only.

operationalEvidencePosture.failClosed: readiness, task, query, and cleanup failures fail proof closed
operationalEvidencePosture.structuredLogging: value-free proof output only; no provider payloads
operationalEvidencePosture.tracingCorrelation: trace and correlation hash evidence captured
operationalEvidencePosture.metrics: readiness attempts retry count failure count latency bucket and health status captured
operationalEvidencePosture.auditEvents: value-free adapter evidence captured; API/worker audit not claimed
operationalEvidencePosture.redaction: raw endpoints credentials SDK errors stack traces provider payloads and documents are not emitted
